description.en: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness by mysterycode-liwen.
description.zh: mysterycode-liwen 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Sidebar email client for QQ, 163, Gmail and other IMAP/SMTP accounts. Attachments, unread badge, read/unread filters, new-mail alerts via desktop pet or system notification, and credentials stored locally in the DSH vault.
description.zh: 侧边栏邮件客户端，支持 QQ、163、Gmail 等 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱。可收发附件，带未读角标与已读/未读筛选，新邮件由桌宠或系统通知提醒，授权码保存在本机凭据保险箱。
